record.context_brief: Bogomolov inequality for a P^6 complete intersection
record.original_question: Let X be a Calabi-Yau threefold given as a complete intersection of one cubic hypersurface and two quadric hypersurfaces in P^6. Is it possible to prove a stronger Bogomolov inequality for slope-semistable torsion-free sheaves on X, analogous to the inequalities proved in the cited quintic and quadric-quartic cases, in a way that implies inequality (4.5)?

evidence.quote: Question 4.12. Let X be a complete intersection of a cubic and two quadric hypersurfaces in P6 . Is it possible to show a stronger Bogomolov inequality for slope semistable torsion free sheaves on X, similarly to [96, Theorem 1.1], [103, Proposition 1.1], which implies (4.5)?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X \subset \mathbb{P}^6$ be a smooth Calabi–Yau threefold obtained as the complete intersection of one cubic hypersurface and two quadric hypersurfaces, and let $H$ denote the restriction of the hyperplane class of $\mathbb{P}^6$ to $X$. For a torsion-free coherent sheaf $E$ on $X$, write $\mathrm{ch}^s(E) = e^{-sH}\,\mathrm{ch}(E)$ for the twisted Chern character with twist parameter $s \in \mathbb{R}$, and set
$$\Delta_H(E) = (H^2\,\mathrm{ch}_1(E))^2 - 2\,(H^3\,\mathrm{ch}_0(E))(H\,\mathrm{ch}_2(E)).$$
For real parameters $q,s$ with $q > s^2/2$, consider the inequality
$$(2q - s^2)\,\Delta_H(E) \;+\; 4\,(H\,\mathrm{ch}^{\,s}_2(E))^2 \;-\; 6\,H^2\,\mathrm{ch}^{\,s}_1(E)\cdot \mathrm{ch}^{\,s}_3(E) \;\ge\; 0. \qquad (\star)$$

Prove (or disprove) a strengthened Bogomolov–Gieseker type inequality for $H$-slope-semistable torsion-free sheaves on $X$ — in the spirit of the strengthened inequalities established for the smooth quintic threefold in $\mathbb{P}^4$ and for the complete intersection of a quadric and a quartic in $\mathbb{P}^5$ — that is strong enough to imply $(\star)$ for all tilt-semistable objects on $X$ in the relevant parameter range, thereby yielding the construction of Bridgeland stability conditions on $D^b(X)$.
artifact.status_search_result: Strengthened Bogomolov–Gieseker inequalities of this type were previously known for the quintic threefold and for the (2,4) complete intersection in P^5. A 2025 preprint reduces the BMT/Γ-BMT conjecture for complete intersection Calabi–Yau threefolds in (weighted) projective space with Picard rank one to a Brill–Noether-type inequality on hyperplane curves and claims the inequality for a broad class of CICYs including those in projective space generated by a very ample H; the (2,2,3) complete intersection in P^6 fits in this class, although it is not enumerated explicitly. Hence the problem appears at least partially resolved, with no widely cited direct verification of (4.5) specific to X_{2,2,3} found.

status_evidence.title: Stability conditions on Calabi–Yau threefolds via Brill–Noether theory of curves
status_evidence.snippet: We prove this inequality for a broad class of Calabi–Yau threefolds, including complete intersection Calabi–Yau threefolds in weighted projective spaces.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work proves the relevant BG-type inequality for complete intersection Calabi–Yau threefolds in (weighted) projective spaces with Picard rank one, a class containing the (2,2,3) complete intersection in P^6.

status_evidence.title: Stability condition on Calabi–Yau threefold of complete intersection of quadratic and quartic hypersurfaces
status_evidence.snippet: A Bogomolov–Gieseker type inequality on X_{2,4} is proved, implying existence of Bridgeland stability conditions.
status_evidence.claim: Analogous strengthened inequalities were previously proved for the quintic and (2,4) complete intersections, motivating the question for (2,2,3).

status_evidence.title: On stability conditions for the quintic threefold
status_evidence.snippet: Proves a generalized Bogomolov–Gieseker inequality on the quintic threefold and constructs stability conditions.
status_evidence.claim: The quintic case provides a model for the strengthened inequality sought.
